title: PR
subtitle: Journalists, data studies and 1:1 pitches from press@boat4you.com: you read every pitch and send it yourself.

ui.actionError: That did not work. Try again.

decision.tripadvisorForbidden: Names a review platform we never mention
decision.suppressed: Address is on the suppression list
decision.doNotContact: Contact is marked do not contact
decision.noEmailSource: No source for the address (URL and date)
decision.deNoColdEmail: Germany: no cold email without consent
decision.followUpParentAnswered: The pitch was already answered: no follow-up
decision.followUpTooEarly: Follow-up too early (5 days after sending)

overview.followUpsHint: Sent 5 or more days ago, no reply recorded, no follow-up yet.

contacts.search: Search name, email, role or outlet
contacts.name: Name
contacts.emailSourceHint: The public page that shows this address (staff page, article footer, author profile).
contacts.marketHint: ISO code: GB (not UK), US, AU, DE … Empty = the outlet's market.
contacts.marketRequired: Required when no outlet is chosen.
contacts.required: Required: without it the contact can never be emailed.
contacts.confirmSuppress: {{email}} goes on the suppression list: every contact with this address (at any outlet) stops receiving mail. This cannot be undone here.
contacts.importHint: UTF-8 CSV, header row first. Required columns: market, outlet, tier, email. UK and English country names become ISO codes. A row without email still saves its outlet.

pitches.consentNoStudy: A consent request is not tied to a study.
pitches.subject: Subject
pitches.draftCreated: Draft saved. It is not sent until you press Send.
pitches.asSent: Exactly as it will be sent (with the footer)
pitches.failedWarning: The message may already have reached the journalist. Check the copy in the press@ mailbox before you send again.
pitches.stuck: Being sent, or stuck after an interruption. No action is possible here; if it stays like this, check the press@ copy and ask for a manual fix.
pitches.confirmSendHint: Sent 1:1 from press@boat4you.com as plain text, with a copy to press@.
pitches.sendUnclear: Status after sending: {{status}}. Check the list.
pitches.sendError: Result unknown (the connection dropped or the server did not answer). The pitch may have been sent: check the list and the press@ copy before doing anything else.
pitches.optOut: Opt this address out — never email it again
pitches.optOutHint: {{email}} goes on the suppression list: no contact with this address will receive mail again.
pitches.confirmBounce: {{email}} goes on the suppression list: no contact with this address will receive mail again.
pitches.followUpHint: Subject: Re: {{subject}}. Saved as a draft; you send it like any pitch.

placements.targetUrl: Our page it should link to
placements.targetHint: For the record: the check looks for a link to any of our seven sites.
placements.saved: Article added. Press Check now to check the link.

mentions.feedsHint: RSS or Atom (Google Alerts, Talkwalker), read every 6 hours.
